svg.title: Randomization distribution: 1,000 shuffled differences, with the observed difference of 6.1 minutes marked
svg.desc: Dot plot of 1,000 shuffled differences in mean time to fall asleep, centered near 0 and ranging from −7.9 to 8.1 minutes. A line marks the observed 6.1; 16 shuffles are at or above it.
svg.text: Each dot is one shuffle (1,000 shuffles, assuming the phone habit has no effect)
Shuffled difference in means, usual − phones away (minutes)
